Options.Description.ExportButton: Export in-game objects as geospatial files.
Options.Description.SourceCRS: The coordinate reference system (CRS) used for input coordinates.
Options.Description.SourceXCoord: The X value of the coordinate. For WGS84, this is the longitude in decimal degrees; for UTM and other Transverse Mercator systems, it's the easting in meters.
Options.Description.SourceYCoord: The Y value of the coordinate. For WGS84, this is the latitude in decimal degrees; for UTM and other Transverse Mercator systems, it's the northing in meters.
Options.Description.SourceHemisphere: Specifies whether the coordinate is in the Northern or Southern Hemisphere.
Options.Description.SourceUTMZone: The UTM zone number for the coordinate location. Valid values range from 1 to 60.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoid: The reference ellipsoid used for the Transverse Mercator projection.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoidSemiM: Length of the semi-major axis of the ellipsoid, in meters.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoidInver: The inverse flattening (1/f) of the ellipsoid.
Options.Description.SourceCRSOriginLongi: Longitude of the projection origin in WGS84 decimal degrees, also called the central meridian.
Options.Description.SourceCRSOriginLatit: Latitude of the projection origin in WGS84 decimal degrees.
Options.Description.SourceCRSFalseEastin: Offset added to the X-axis (easting) in meters.
Options.Description.SourceCRSFalseNorthi: Offset added to the Y-axis (northing) in meters.
Options.Description.SourceCRSScaleFactor: A scale factor applied to distances from the origin. Typically slightly less than 1.
Options.Description.SourceCRSTransform: Helmert Transform parameters for converting the current datum to WGS84. Enter values separated by spaces.
